newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Gilts to power higher, reach for 113-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Gilts to power higher, reach for 113-16.

text.p: September gilt futures are likely to build on Wednesday's consolidation and look to break higher, testing 113-16, technical analysts said on Wednesday.

"If we break through resistance at 113-13 we will see an intial test of 113-16 and that should trigger a return to the recent highs," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM Yieldwatch in London.
Branigan said a break above there could lay the way for a return to the contract highs reached in early May this year.
At 0706 GMT, September gilt futures were 3/32 lower at 113-09.
"A break of 113-27 should trigger gains leading up towards contract highs again," he said.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said gilts had the potential to move higher but said the contract high of 114-31 was likely to remain out of reach in the near term.

"Layers of resistance at 114-00 (wave extension), 114-02,03 (gap from mid-May) and 114-07 (76.4 percent retracement) are likely to limit upticks keeping contract highs at 114-31 well protected," they said in a note to clients.
Branigan said a failure to break higher could lead to a test down through Wednesday's lows below 113-00.
"Below 113-00 we're going to be reaching the first correction of the gains from the 111-30 low and finding support there," Branigan said.
He pegged support at 112-28 and then at 112-21 below there.
DMG analysts said immediate support was clear at the 113-00 congestion zone with trendline support at 112-16 providing the next level to watch.
"(112-16) needs to hold to keep the critical bear trigger at 111-30 out of the firing line," they said.
By 0740 GMT, September short sterling was one basis point lower at 93.15.
